subject.scene_narrative: A young woman in profile assembles a cute two-part robot while holding a phone showing a success checkmark icon — the same full-body flat vector language as the approved Q1 references.
subject.hero_prop: round white robot with charcoal visor and teal chest dots, partially assembled
subject.environment: thin grey floor line only, two faint grey circles behind figure — no room interior

composition.layout: figure left-of-center, hero prop right, balanced like 1.1.png

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, letter R, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. Style MUST match KursoKo reference assets 1.1.png and 1.2.png: unDraw-inspired edu character, thin 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, flat color fills, minimal dot-eye face. Young college-age woman in side profile, light peach skin, dark hair in bun, purple #4B2C7F tee with charcoal sleeves and subtle teal #4DB6AC cuff stripe, charcoal high-waist pants and flats. She builds a cute round white robot with charcoal visor and teal LED dots — holding chassis, fitting a brass gear. Optional phone with checkmark icon like reference 1.1. Thin grey floor line, faint grey decorative circles only — NO opaque background, NO text, NO letter, NO border frame. Subtle Realistic RIASEC accent teal on robot and wires. Friendly maker energy. Full head-to-feet visible.
